assumptions.losses: U1 0.6 W, U41 0.5 W, U61 0.25 W are hypothetical; no measured device losses.
assumptions.materials: 0.3 W/mK dielectric, 385 W/mK copper and 0.025 mm via plating are illustrative values, not coupon measurements.
assumptions.cooling: Top and bottom convection are prescribed at 10 W/m2K; airflow is not solved.
assumptions.package_paths: Junction-case and case-board resistances are assumed; package geometry is not resolved.
assumptions.scope: Layered board finite-volume model: one depth cell per imported stackup row; rectangular board bounds. Zones are excluded because this board import lacks trustworthy source-filled zone copper. Not a full 3D package/airflow solve.
